title: Mike and Frog
statementMd:
Mike has a frog and a flower. His frog is named Xaniar and his flower is named Abol. Initially(at time $0$), height of Xaniar is $*h*_{1}$ and height of Abol is $*h*_{2}$. Each second, Mike waters Abol and Xaniar.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be1cd5c5fe7ed9396a94cdb3bde214f0eb8866ce.png)

So, if height of Xaniar is $*h*_{1}$ and height of Abol is $*h*_{2}$, after one second height of Xaniar will become ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2fe18334e8025eeb03e58258a1a73999e06eaded.png) and height of Abol will become ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc063cc983b60502463ef52c01f1c9f44150fd93.png) where $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}$ and $*y*_{2}$ are some integer numbers and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/57fc4a50a6c33bac9327d8c392910a6dbf5c89bb.png) denotes the remainder of $*a*$ modulo $*b*$.

Mike is a competitive programmer fan. He wants to know the minimum time it takes until height of Xania is $*a*_{1}$ and height of Abol is $*a*_{2}$.

Mike has asked you for your help. Calculate the minimum time or say it will never happen.

## Input

The first line of input contains integer $*m*$ ($2 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{6}$).

The second line of input contains integers $*h*_{1}$ and $*a*_{1}$ ($0 ≤ *h*_{1}, *a*_{1} < *m*$).

The third line of input contains integers $*x*_{1}$ and $*y*_{1}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{1}, *y*_{1} < *m*$).

The fourth line of input contains integers $*h*_{2}$ and $*a*_{2}$ ($0 ≤ *h*_{2}, *a*_{2} < *m*$).

The fifth line of input contains integers $*x*_{2}$ and $*y*_{2}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{2}, *y*_{2} < *m*$).

It is guaranteed that $*h*_{1} ≠ *a*_{1}$ and $*h*_{2} ≠ *a*_{2}$.

## Output

Print the minimum number of seconds until Xaniar reaches height $*a*_{1}$ and Abol reaches height $*a*_{2}$ or print -1 otherwise.

## Note

In the first sample, heights sequences are following:

Xaniar: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/85da629b05969e7a8a6636d995b8fe7a0494e8f4.png)

Abol: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ea95da14490864ae8b8bfcd4a8b7c02ad3a666b3.png)
statementZhMd:
迈克有一只青蛙和一朵花。他的青蛙名叫 Xaniar，花名叫 Abol。初始时（时间 $0$），Xaniar 的高度为 *h*$_{1}$，Abol 的高度为 *h*$_{2}$。每秒，迈克都会给 Abol 和 Xaniar 浇水。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be1cd5c5fe7ed9396a94cdb3bde214f0eb8866ce.png)

因此，如果 Xaniar 的高度为 *h*$_{1}$，Abol 的高度为 *h*$_{2}$，那么一秒后，Xaniar 的高度将变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2fe18334e8025eeb03e58258a1a73999e06eaded.png)，Abol 的高度将变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc063cc983b60502463ef52c01f1c9f44150fd93.png)，其中 *x*$_{1}$、 *y*$_{1}$、 *x*$_{2}$ 和 *y*$_{2}$ 是一些整数，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/57fc4a50a6c33bac9327d8c392910a6dbf5c89bb.png) 表示 *a* 除以 *b* 的余数。

迈克是一名竞赛编程爱好者。他想知道，最少需要多长时间，Xaniar 的高度才能变为 *a*$_{1}$，同时 Abol 的高度变为 *a*$_{2}$。

迈克向你寻求帮助。请计算达到目标所需的最少时间，或者判断目标永远无法实现。

## 输入

输入的第一行包含一个整数 *m*（$2 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{6}$）。

输入的第二行包含整数 *h*$_{1}$ 和 *a*$_{1}$（$0 ≤ *h*$_{1}$, *a*$_{1}$ < *m*$）。

输入的第三行包含整数 *x*$_{1}$ 和 *y*$_{1}$（$0 ≤ *x*$_{1}$, *y*$_{1}$ < *m*$）。

输入的第四行包含整数 *h*$_{2}$ 和 *a*$_{2}$（$0 ≤ *h*$_{2}$, *a*$_{2}$ < *m*$）。

输入的第五行包含整数 *x*$_{2}$ 和 *y*$_{2}$（$0 ≤ *x*$_{2}$, *y*$_{2}$ < *m*$）。

保证 *h*$_{1}$ ≠ *a*$_{1}$ 且 *h*$_{2}$ ≠ *a*$_{2}$。

## 输出

输出 Xaniar 的高度达到 *a*$_{1}$ 且 Abol 的高度达到 *a*$_{2}$ 所需的最少秒数；如果无法实现，则输出 -1。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，高度序列如下：

Xaniar：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/85da629b05969e7a8a6636d995b8fe7a0494e8f4.png)

Abol：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ea95da14490864ae8b8bfcd4a8b7c02ad3a666b3.png)
